criteria.description: Phase 0 evidence recorded in the guide's Measured section
criteria.note: Documentation criterion. The guide's '## Measured' section (lines 49-63) names tinker-city task.127 merged as PR #984 on 2026-10-02 (line 51). It also gives the real skipped run 41445192250 (line 59: docs-only, 3 .md files, d88b1f96, all heavy jobs skipped). These are the task's PR and one real skipped run, which is what the criterion asks for.

criteria.description: Docs-only synchronize over green pull_request run of CI_WORKFLOW_PATH gives code=false
criteria.note: Line 160 runs the jq check of the CI_WORKFLOW_PATH workflow's successful pull_request runs, and line 227 then emits false. The test 'docs increment on a successful PR run of the workflow → false' asserts code=false. The spec is reached by package.json test:suite glob 'docs/examples/ci/*/*.test.js', and .github/workflows/test.yml runs npm test on every pull_request with no path filter. NEEDS_JQ cannot silently skip on Actions because the guard at classify-changes.test.js:378 fails when jq is missing.

criteria.description: Every lookup failure and unset CI_WORKFLOW_PATH gives code=true, both platforms
criteria.note: No unmapped members. Bitbucket's 403 handling is in bitbucket-pipelines/classify-changes.sh:115. The Bitbucket variant has no CI_WORKFLOW_PATH input: its evidence is the parent's pull-request pipelines (classify-changes.sh:74). So the unset-CI_WORKFLOW_PATH half applies to GitHub only. Both specs run in npm test via test.yml on every PR.

criteria.description: Parity test passes on the fixed path list
criteria.note: The test compares the template's DEFAULT_DOCS_PATTERNS ('*.md docs/*', via the sourced is_docs) with task.172 DEFAULT_PATTERNS via matchesAnyGlob, on FIXED_PATHS (line 27). Line 54 pins the pipeline default as non-vacuous. QA cycle 3 records ci:fast with 7116 tests and 0 failures. The test is reached by the 'docs/examples/ci/*/*.test.js' glob, and test.yml runs it per PR.

criteria.description: Guide quotes measured before/after from Phase 0's real run
criteria.note: Documentation criterion. The criterion states no numeric bound, so it is not a measured criterion; its deliverable is what the guide says. Lines 57-59 quote real run IDs on the same ci.yml: 41439187444, a code push at 37 min 27 s; 41444278348, docs-only at 3 min 42 s; 41445192250, docs-only at 2 min 52 s. These are measured run figures, not an estimate.

criteria.description: Specs run in npm test, reached per test-runner-reach.test.js
criteria.note: test:suite ends with the glob 'docs/examples/ci/*/*.test.js', which matches all four new spec files. 'every tracked test file is reached by npm test' (line 107) runs in the 'tests/*.test.js' glob, which test.yml runs on every pull_request. QA report 1 records M7: removing the glob makes the reach test name all the suites (3 at that time).

criteria.description: Each § 8 mutation proof turns a test red, recorded in QA report
criteria.note: Process criterion; the units are the three mutation proofs named in task § 8. criteria-drift.js re-run gives reason clean, changed [], exit 0. Line 295 now reads the reviewed text, '…recorded in the QA report'. Each unit has a committed record in QA report 1 (tracked and unmodified) naming the mutation and the test that went red. Line 158: lookup failure returns 0, caught by the lookup-file-missing and curl-non-zero tests (classify-changes.test.js:545, :659). Line 159: CI_WORKFLOW_PATH guard disabled, caught by the unset and empty tests (:746). Line 162: Bitbucket 403 treated as 200, caught by '403 → true' (bitbucket classify-changes.test.js:281). No uncovered units.

criteria.description: npm run ci green incl. lint:shell; docs-link-check clean on guide
criteria.note: resolved from CI reading 1: SUCCESS @ 1a8ac32879d91b62663dbc2bee6ae66d9db61fa4 — CI-state criterion. Both halves are CI lanes on the PR head. The npm run ci composite (package.json:24) is mirrored by test.yml, shellcheck.yml (lint:shell twin) and validate.yml. docs-link-check is .github/workflows/docs-link-check.yml, which fires because the PR changes docs/**/*.md including docs/runbooks/ci-docs-only-skip.md. Step 6 grades it from CI reading 1.

criteria.description: Guide states adoption is optional and the fail-safe contract
criteria.note: Documentation criterion. Lines 3-4 call it an **optional** CI template that nothing installs, and line 13 says 'Adopting it is optional'. Lines 33-47 ('The contract: every uncertain path runs the full suite') list each uncertain path giving code=true, and say code is written on every exit. Line 132's 'this is not optional' applies only to PR-only cancellation once adopted. QA cycle 3 flagged that wording as advisory; it does not contradict optional adoption.

Documentation criterion. CHANGELOG.md:9-18, under [Unreleased], has the entry 'An optional CI template that skips the heavy jobs on a docs-only push (task 174)'. It describes both variants, the 403 trap, the guide link and the measured 37 min 27 s against 2 min 52 s. changelog-entry-drift.test.mjs is the corpus guard and runs in npm test. It is a post-merge guard: it checks accepted tasks whose PR merged since the last tag, so it pins this entry only after merge.
